rulebook.title: Rulebook

columns.name: Name
columns.description: The tag's name; one row per tag.

columns.name: Judged
columns.description: Ticked: the agent judges this tag on every claim. Untick to stop judging it; its rules then change freely until it is ticked again.

columns.name: Category
columns.description: The tag's group.

columns.name: Counterpart
columns.description: The opposite tag it pairs with (Self-contained for Context-dependent).

columns.name: Description
columns.description: One or two sentences describing a claim that carries the tag.

columns.name: Evidence
columns.description: The report the tag's verification rests on.

columns.name: Example Claims
columns.description: Claims that show the tag, one per line.

columns.name: Geo Status
columns.description: Whether the tag exists in Geo.

columns.name: Geo Tag ID
columns.description: The tag's id in Geo.

columns.name: Polarity
columns.description: Kept as in the taxonomy; the agent does not use it.

columns.name: Status
columns.description: Whether the tag is verified.

columns.name: Verified on
columns.description: When the tag was verified.

columns.name: When to use
columns.description: The numbered rules the agent applies; a tag is judged only when this holds rules.

columns.name: Work tags
columns.description: The work the tag belongs to; every row here has Issue.

columns.name: Created
columns.description: When the row was made.

columns.name: Created by
columns.description: Who made the row.

columns.name: Last edited
columns.description: When the row last changed.

columns.name: Last edited by
columns.description: Who last changed the row.

rulebook.description: One row per tag; When to use holds the rules the agent applies. Rules change when you approve a change in Lessons waiting.

claims.title: Claims

columns.name: Geo Name
columns.description: The claim text.

columns.name: Agent tags
columns.description: The tags that apply, from the Rulebook: the ones you decided Applies in Tag decisions, and the ones the agent applies where nothing waits for you. Tags that wait for you are in Tags waiting instead.

columns.name: Agent confidence
columns.description: How sure the agent is: the lowest confidence among the tags it judged on the claim, from 0.5 (a coin flip) to 1 (certain).

columns.name: Agent reasons
columns.description: Why the agent proposed what it did: one line per judged tag, "<Tag>: <reason> · <rule cited> · <k> of <n> runs agree".

columns.name: Agent status
columns.description: What the agent says about the claim as a whole: Waits for you (one of its tags waits in Your queue), Done, Disagrees with your decision (on one of its tags), or Could not read. You decide in Tag decisions, not here.

columns.name: Tags waiting
columns.description: The tags of this claim that wait for your decision in Your queue, from the Rulebook. Empty when nothing waits.

columns.name: Agent edition
columns.description: The rulebook edition the agent wrote this row under.

columns.name: Agent remarks
columns.description: What the agent could not check, such as "not checked: 6 tags without rules"; empty when it checked everything.

columns.name: Agent's view of your decision
columns.description: One line per tag where you differed from the agent: what it made of it (Agent slip, Rule unclear, Rule should change), the rule and why. More on the tag's row.

columns.name: Tag decisions
columns.description: This claim's rows in Tag decisions, one per tag the agent judged. Click one to decide it.

columns.name: Geo ID
columns.description: The claim's identity in Geo; the Key of its rows in Tag decisions starts with it.

columns.name: Geo URL
columns.description: The claim's page in Geo.

columns.name: Geo Space
columns.description: The Geo space the claim was read from.

columns.name: Geo Created
columns.description: The day the claim was made in Geo.

columns.name: Geo Sources
columns.description: The claim's sources, as Geo lists them.

columns.name: Geo Is factual
columns.description: Ticked when Geo marks the claim as factual.

columns.name: Geo Tags
columns.description: The claim's tags in Geo.

columns.name: Geo Topics
columns.description: The claim's topics in Geo.

claims.description: Claims read from Geo, with the agent's summary of each. Read only: you decide each claim and tag in Tag decisions.

tag_decisions.title: Tag decisions

columns.name: Claim
columns.description: The claim text.

columns.name: Open claim
columns.description: The claim's row in Claims; open it for the claim's sources and its Geo link.

columns.name: Tag
columns.description: The tag the row is about.

columns.name: Agent proposal
columns.description: The agent's answer for this claim and tag.

columns.name: Agent confidence
columns.description: How sure the agent is of its answer, from 0.5 (a coin flip) to 1 (certain); Your queue is sorted by it, lowest first.

columns.name: Agent reason
columns.description: At most 40 words, then the rule cited and how many runs agreed.

columns.name: Agent is right
columns.description: Tick when you agree with the agent's answer; that is your decision and Tag outcome stays empty. On Can't tell, don't tick: set Tag outcome. Tag outcome wins if both are set.

columns.name: Tag outcome
columns.description: Your decision on this claim and tag; it always wins over the agent's answer. Empty, with Agent is right not ticked, means the row waits in Your queue.

columns.name: Your note
columns.description: Your words, when you want to say something, such as why the agent's answer is wrong. Plain language; you don't need to name a rule or a reason, the agent works that out.

columns.name: Agent status
columns.description: What the agent says about this row: Waits for you (it needs your decision), Done, Disagrees with your decision (a later run answered otherwise), or Could not read.

columns.name: Agent's view of your decision
columns.description: What the agent made of your decision where you differed from it: Agent slip (the rules already settle it your way), Rule unclear (they read both ways) or Rule should change (they decide against you). The agent works this out from your decision, your note and the rulebook.

columns.name: Rule
columns.description: The rule the agent's view points at, for example "Context-dependent rule 3".

columns.name: Why the agent thinks so
columns.description: One line of why. It opens with "without your note" when you wrote nothing.

columns.name: After the rule change
columns.description: Empty until a rule change goes live. Then Fixed if the new rule gives your decision on this row, Still wrong if it doesn't.

columns.name: Key
columns.description: The claim's Geo ID, two colons, the tag; one row per claim and tag.

columns.name: Rulebook edition
columns.description: The edition the proposal was made under.

columns.name: Decided under
columns.description: The edition the proposal you decided on was made under; the agent records it when it first finds your Tag outcome.

columns.name: Read under
columns.description: The edition and a short mark of what the reading rests on: your decision, your note and the proposal the agent made. The agent reads a row again only when one of those changes.

tag_decisions.description: One row per claim and tag the agent judged. Decide here: tick Agent is right or set Tag outcome; add Your note when you have something to say.

rule_changes.title: Rule changes

columns.name: Lesson
columns.description: A short name for the change.

columns.name: Tag
columns.description: The tag the change is about.

columns.name: Rule
columns.description: Which rule, for example "Context-dependent rule 3".

columns.name: Kind
columns.description: What kind of change.

columns.name: Current text
columns.description: The rule's text now.

columns.name: Proposed text
columns.description: The text the agent proposes.

columns.name: Safety check result
columns.description: For example "PASS: examples 11/11, earlier 10/10, yours 2/2" or "FAIL: 'Excluding CNN from Air Force One violates the federal court order' now Does not apply".

columns.name: Supporting rows
columns.description: One line per decided row the change rests on: the claim shortened, " · ", the row's Key.

columns.name: Editor wording
columns.description: The rule as the editor words it; when filled, the safety check tests it instead of the Proposed text. Never written by the agent.

columns.name: Status
columns.description: The editor sets Approved and Rejected; the agent sets Proposed, Live and Rolled back.

rule_changes.description: Rule changes the agent drafted. The rule owner sets Approved or Rejected.

agent_settings.title: Agent settings

columns.name: Name
columns.description: The row's name, Claim tagger.

columns.name: Paused
columns.description: Ticked by a person, every command then refuses; cleared by a person.

columns.name: Rulebook edition
columns.description: The edition in force: a date plus a count, such as 2026-10-16.1; it goes up when a rule changes.

columns.name: Last run summary
columns.description: One short line, such as "Promote · 16 Oct 11:20 · PASS".

agent_settings.description: Tick Paused to stop every command; untick to resume.

views.name: Your queue
views.filter: Agent status is Waits for you, and Tag outcome is empty, and (Agent is right is not ticked, or Agent proposal is Can't tell)
views.sort: Claim, A to Z; then Agent confidence, lowest first

views.name: Needs your note
views.filter: Why the agent thinks so contains "without your note"
views.sort: Claim, A to Z; then Agent confidence, lowest first

views.name: Agent disagreed
views.filter: Agent status is Disagrees with your decision
views.sort: Claim, A to Z; then Agent confidence, lowest first

hub.title: Claim tagger v2
hub.note: Decide each claim and tag in Tag decisions: tick Agent is right or set Tag outcome. The first page, "Claim tagger", is kept for reference.
note_was: In preparation and not in use yet: claims are still decided on the Claims table of "Claim tagger".

link_text.your_queue: the rows, a claim and one tag, that wait for your decision
link_text.needs_your_note: rows where you overruled the agent and left no note
link_text.agent_disagreed: rows where the agent's newest answer differs from your decision

view_hints.your_queue: Agree with the agent? Tick Agent is right. Disagree, or it says Can't tell? Set Tag outcome. The row then leaves this list.
view_hints.needs_your_note: You overruled the agent without a note. Say why in Your note, in plain words. The row leaves this list after the agent next reads your notes.
view_hints.agent_disagreed: The agent now answers otherwise. If it is right, set Tag outcome to match. If not, say why in Your note.
view_hints.lessons_waiting: Rule changes the agent proposes. Set Status to Approved or Rejected. To word the rule yourself, fill Editor wording first.
